1.w: A song, a psalm by the Korahites. The Lord is great and certainly worthy of praise in the city of our God, his holy hill.

2.w: It is lofty and pleasing to look at, a source of joy to the whole earth. Mount Zion resembles the peaks of Zaphon; it is the city of the great king.

3.w: God is in its fortresses; he reveals himself as its defender.

4.w: For look, the kings assemble; they advance together.

5.w: As soon as they see, they are shocked; they are terrified, they quickly retreat.

6.w: Look at them shake uncontrollably, like a woman writhing in childbirth.

7.w: With an east wind you shatter the large ships.

8.w: We heard about God’s mighty deeds; now we have seen them, in the city of the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, in the city of our God. God makes it permanently secure. (Selah)

9.w: Within your temple we reflect on your loyal love, O God.

10.w: The praise you receive as far away as the ends of the earth is worthy of your reputation, O God. You execute justice.

11.w: Mount Zion rejoices; the towns of Judah are happy, because of your acts of judgment.

12.w: Walk around Zion. Encircle it. Count its towers.

13.w: Consider its defenses. Walk through its fortresses, so you can tell the next generation about it.

14.w: For God, our God, is our defender forever. He guides us.
